The project's backlog directory (backlog/, .backlog/ or a configured path) inside the developer's repository. It holds tasks, drafts, completed and archived tasks, documents, decisions, milestones and config.yml. These files are the source of truth: readable with ordinary tools, reviewable in Git diffs, and owned by the project rather than by Backlog.md.
